_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Here is what you can build

description: Use this when the user asks what they can build or play and a ranked list helps: the decks already in Reliquary, most complete first, each with a picture, the share of its list at hand and the first cards it misses, optionally for one format. Reads the same data as what_can_i_build and changes nothing. "At hand" counts claimed, shared and free copies together: 100% does not mean sleeved, and a deck at 100% may share copies with another deck. A deck that is not in Reliquary is not ranked: import it first.
name: show_buildable_decks

coverable.description: Claimed, shared and free copies together: 100% is not sleeved

image_uri.description: The card's picture on Scryfall, to show as it is; null when the catalogue has none

missing_links.description: The cards in missing_cards with their Scryfall pages: link each name

scryfall_url.description: The card's page on Scryfall: link the card's name to it

title: Show what can be built
